summary: rebase the P04 contracts onto the T038 two-pool ten-million-block dataset generation
owner_direction:
Owner direction for the P04 SPEC amendment (2026-09-18).

1. CONTEXT - the P04 input changes, and why.
The 2026-09-18 reference dataset (run-680e65f4a59842d98b1712a45280779d) does NOT satisfy the Phase 3 exit gate and is NOT a Phase 4 input. Its event_index records 3,739 rows across 3,266 distinct event blocks while its Parquet partitions hold 3,737 rows across 3,264, with Swap at 3,157 against the pinned baseline 3,159, so its own baseline comparison fails closed. The cause is a storage-writer defect, not a chain event: when a collection interval writes forward-progress blocks into a partition cell an earlier interval already created, RawPartitionWriter._merge_into_existing_partition appends only to event_index and deliberately does not modify the Parquet file (src/robinhood_lp/storage/writer.py:557-585, reached from src/robinhood_lp/ingestion/runner.py:887-929). The affected run reported complete=1 and recorded no reorg, conflict or deviation. That dataset remains immutable historical evidence: no P04 task may repair, re-qualify, overwrite or merge it, and no P04 contract may cite it as a satisfied entry condition.

2. THE NEW P04 INPUT is the dataset generation produced by T038, which depends on T037. Owner decisions recorded 2026-09-18:
 (a) the window end is a finalized block agreed by both qualified endpoints and pinned by number and hash; never latest, and never a wall-clock-derived bound;
 (b) the window start is min(end - 10,000,000, the Initialize block of each included pool); the start is extended below end - 10,000,000 only when a pool's Initialize lies within 2,000,000 blocks of it; a pool further below is reported pool_init_outside_window and excluded from the qualified dataset;
 (c) the already pinned ZZZ/USDG reference pool is re-acquired cold inside that window, from its Initialize block at 54946237;
 (d) a second Owner-pinned pool is included: PoolId 0xEd50bDeeA8aDC232f159486192a4157281D722ff on chain id 4663. Its PoolKey and Initialize block were NOT supplied and are resolved on chain by T038, then verified by keccak256(abi.encode(PoolKey)) == PoolId;
 (e) the previous 1,000,001-block reference range is no longer the research range: the ten-million-block window supersedes it. Each included pool has its own data root and its own T034 report.

3. REQUIRED CHANGES TO THE FOUR TARGET CONTRACTS. All four keep their status PLANNED, attempt 0, and identity; only their bodies and their dependency fields change.
 - T040: add T037 and T038 to Dependencies and References. State that replay consumes the per-pool datasets T038 qualifies, one data root per pool, and that replay must not depend on the superseded 2026-09-18 dataset. Keep the existing ProtocolFeeUpdated requirement and the dynamic-fee clause unchanged.
 - T041: add T037 and T038 to Dependencies and References. State that tick and liquidity reconstruction is per pool over that pool's qualified window, and that a pool whose Initialize is not inside its window is not reconstructed.
 - T042: add T038 to Dependencies and References. (i) Name the two pools as the heterogeneous set, so the acceptance clause "heterogeneous pools" is satisfied by T038's datasets rather than by an unspecified future source. (ii) State the historical-state routing rule explicitly: block-pinned StateView reads must be issued to an endpoint that can serve historical state at that depth; an endpoint that cannot serve it is a blocked check, never a latest substitution. (iii) Add explicit bounds so cost is bounded and reviewable: the number of heights compared, the per-height read list, and a logical-call and compute-unit budget ceiling that the run records. (iv) Reference the per-partition event_index-versus-Parquet reconciliation delivered by T037 instead of re-implementing it.
 - T043: state the evidence shape for the case where zero hooked pools are promoted. If neither included pool has nonzero hooks, the task must define and record the empty-set evidence - the per-pool T023 classification outcome and the reason no hook pack exists - so its acceptance can be reviewed independently, and it must not be reported as though hook semantics had been verified. Do not weaken the requirement that any pool with nonzero hooks promoted beyond ingestion needs a complete pack, and do not equate hook flags with semantics.
 - T040, T041, T042 and T043: References must include T037, T038, ADR-010, ADR-012 and docs/spec/protocol/PROVIDER_FACTS.md.

4. REQUIRED SPEC CHANGES.
 (a) Record the finalized-pinning and window rule above in docs/spec/protocol/PROVIDER_FACTS.md so T038's rule has a spec-level home that P04 can reference; label the values as measured observations with retrieval time, chain id and the endpoint aliases they came from, and mark the mutable ones as requiring a fresh probe per run.
 (b) Record that the 2026-09-18 dataset is superseded and non-qualifying, with the two missing EventKeys and the reason, so a later reader cannot mistake it for a qualified input.
 (c) Add an ADR addendum recording the finalized-pinning policy and the partition-reconciliation requirement. Do not reopen ADR-002, ADR-010, ADR-011 or ADR-012; the addendum refines them and must be registered in the architecture catalogue.
 (d) Raise spec_revision.

5. CONSTRAINTS.
 - Change only the four target contracts, todo/config.yaml dependency fields, spec_revision and docs/spec/**. Do not edit any other task contract, including T030 through T038, and do not attempt to edit the P04 phase README or todo/README.md: both are outside this layer's allowed paths.
 - Do not change any task status, attempt, evidence pointer, commit SHA, review record, approval datum, runtime model or agent configuration.
 - Do not claim that the 2026-09-18 run qualifies anything, and do not cite the 2026-09-17 measured baseline as evidence in place of a run's own report.
 - Two known text inconsistencies are OUT OF SCOPE for this amendment and are recorded here only so they are not silently absorbed: todo/README.md section 6 states that T023 and T043 determine the selected PoolKey's hook identity and semantics while no PoolKey has been selected, and CLAUDE.md and README.md name FLYBRAIN/USDG as an example research target while the pinned pools are ZZZ/USDG and the second Owner-pinned pool. Both files are outside this layer and must be raised to the Owner rather than edited.
 - No credential-bearing URL, API key, authorization header or environment value may be written into any contract or spec file.
